title: Perfect Peace
traveler_why: Tonight is about a mind that will not settle, and Wren the Wonderer is the Traveler whose thoughts spin fast before a first day at a new class — she closes her eyes, thinks about how Heavenly Father loves her, and feels the spinning slow: Isaiah 26:3 at a child’s scale.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she knows that thinking about Heavenly Father brings peace. In Wren’s world today: Wren felt worried about her first day at a new class — her thoughts were spinning fast. So she closed her eyes and thought about how Heavenly Father loved her and was with her. Slowly, her spinning thoughts grew calm and peaceful. Just like Isaiah said keeping our minds on Heavenly Father brings perfect peace, Wren found calm by thinking of Him.
